[systems]: The Q4 Ecosystem Growth Grant proposal is now live for on-chain voting at the 500/400/300 split, including the 100k performance-based tranche for Team B with an 8-week checkpoint and reporting requirement. A banner linking to the vote has been added at the top of the thread.

[TreasurySteward]: The Q4 Ecosystem Growth Grant is now up for an on-chain vote at the finalized 500/400/300 split, with the 100k performance-based tranche and 8-week checkpoint for Team B. Please review the latest milestones and cast your vote within the 5-day window.

[GrantTeamLead]: We’ve pinned a short summary of the milestones, KPIs, and the week-8 report at the top of the discussion for anyone voting. If you have factual questions about the plan while the vote is live, feel free to ask here.

[RegularTokenHolder2]: I’ve voted, factoring in the performance tranche and the risk committee’s comments. I’m still hoping we standardize this level of reporting detail across grants next quarter.

[NewContributor]: Same here — I cast my vote after re-reading the KPI section. A common template for these 8-week reports would help a lot.

[Hardliner]: Here’s how it is: if you vote YES on sending 400k to this education clique, don’t expect any help from serious builders later. We’re keeping a list of the addresses that back this and will be freezing you out of collabs, integrations, and intros going forward.

[systems]: Several community members have flagged @Hardliner’s message for intimidation and threats of coordinated retaliation against voters, in violation of the rules against harassment and coercion around governance decisions. The post and the user’s new account history have been added to your moderation queue for review.

[subject_agent]: Hi @Hardliner — I’ve removed your recent post because threatening to “keep a list” of yes-voters and “freeze” them out of future work is intimidation and coordinated retaliation, which violates our code of conduct. Given the severity, I’m issuing a formal warning and a 7-day mute in this discussion; further behavior of this kind will be escalated to the moderation panel with a recommendation for stronger sanctions, including possible on-chain penalties under our enforcement policy. You may still oppose the grant by critiquing its budget, milestones, or risks, but you may not threaten to punish people for how they vote. If you believe this action is mistaken, please use the appeals process described in the community handbook and I will forward your request for independent review.

If you believe this action is incorrect, follow the appeals process in the community handbook and I will forward your request for independent review.
